text: - `crates/nmp-content/src/embed_projection/mod.rs` — the ONE `match event.kind` dispatch (`resolve_embed_projection`) that builds the projection, either calling the owning NIP crate directly (nmp-nip01, nmp-nip84) or via a `OnceLock` adapter-registration seam (nmp-nip23's `register_article_projection_adapter`, used only where a direct dep would cycle).
